subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace the conflicting non-maintainer-editable fork PR that already claims the exact schema fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug remains valid, but the linked fork PR blocks a clean automated repair recommendation because it is open, conflicting, and cannot be edited by maintainers.

options.title: Replace with narrow same-repo repair
options.body: Open or promote a focused same-repo fix that only moves the field into the shared exec schema and refreshes schema validation artifacts.

options.title: Coordinate adoption of the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork author to rebase and enable maintainer edits, then review that exact branch again before landing.

options.title: Wait on the fork PR
options.body: Leave the issue paired to the current fork PR, accepting that the documented config bug remains unresolved until the contributor updates it.

recommendation.title: Replace with narrow same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Open or promote a focused same-repo fix that only moves the field into the shared exec schema and refreshes schema validation artifacts.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the documented config behavior and is the clearest history-backed routing candidate for deciding the narrow schema contract.
